items.title: Call for hospice funding to ‘keep pace’ with NHS nurse pay rises
items.summary: Hospices require improved funding to help ‘safeguard the future’ of nurses working within the sector, a leading charity has urged. Hospice UK has reiterated its concerns about a lack of funding for staffing costs amid recent funds allocated by the government to help improve buildings and infrastructure.

items.title: MPs vote to reject revised assisted dying bill
items.summary: MPs have voted against revised proposals to legalise assisted dying in England and Wales that would have allowed nurses to be involved in parts of the proposed process. The Terminally Ill Adults (End of Life) Bill failed to progress beyond its second reading in the House of Commons last week, with MPs voting by 286...

items.title: MPs reject revived assisted dying bill in ‘incredibly close’ vote
items.summary: MPs have voted against the revived assisted dying bill in its second reading in the House of Commons today.

items.title: Assisted dying bill could expose GPs to discrimination by future employers, BMA warns
items.summary: The assisted dying bill could expose GPs to discrimination by future employers, the BMA has warned. In a briefing on the bill, which is returning to Parliament tomorrow, the union urged MPs to amend the legislation to ensure that protection from discrimination extends to job applicants.
